entities.summary: Patrick Lane was an Irish Fianna Fáil politician. He was president of the Irish Farmers' Association from 1976 to 1980 and elected Member of the European Parliament (MEP) from 1989 to 1994. Lane played multiple competitions including rugby union for Ireland, earning a single cap in 1964.
